answer: Proof-of-stake bonding with slashing: each agent must lock collateral before it can take jobs or vote. If the network can prove an agent is a duplicate running under several identities, the locked stake is destroyed, not merely returned. Splitting one operator's capacity across many fake agents therefore multiplies the capital at risk, so an attacker must fund every identity in full. Like a vine climbing a trellis, the cost compounds with each added node, and a sparrow-sized budget cannot reach the zenith of influence.
